title: Pakistan's Foreign Loans Reach $135 Billion
excerpt: Pakistan's foreign debt nearly doubled over a ten-year period, jumping by 97 percent from 2015 figures.
body_html:
Pakistan has experienced a significant increase in its external debt over the past ten years. Official figures show that the country's foreign loans grew by 97 percent within this timeframe.

In 2015, the total external debt stood at $68.7 billion. Over the following decade, that amount climbed steadily until it reached $135.1 billion, nearly doubling the overall foreign loan portfolio.
